nom: Caudalie Vinopure Salicylic Acid Pore Minimizing Toner

avis.titre: Fresh and Clean
avis.texte: Origins discontinued United States toner. I used that toner for over a decade. This toner is just as good! I enjoy the fresh /clean smell. This Toner removes old skin cells without my skin feeling tight and dry. It’s pricey , but it’s worth it if you want to splurge.

avis.titre: Never without...Definitely worth it
avis.texte: Love, love, love this product. I hate running out; so i buy extra. I think it works extremely well cleaning my face after washing. I personally think the smell is nice. Its a minty clean smell. I have noticed a difference in my pores and skin since I stated using the toner. This is definitely worth the buy. It does what it says...uike.so many products today.

avis.titre: Helps minimize your pores
avis.texte: This is actually what I have been looking for. Another product I used for years stopped making it a few years ago. Caudalue Vinopure has become my favorite morning and evening.

avis.titre: Save your moneySave your money
avis.texte: It’s a great product and works great but I definitely think this item isn’t worth it for the price. I do love this brand but I think there are cheaper options for a toner that does the same things!

avis.titre: Refreshing clarifying tonerRefreshing clarifying toner
avis.texte: I had been using a purifying toner from another company for years, but last year they stopped shipping to Canada. Since then I’ve spent a lot of money trying to find a similar toner, and this one has everything I was looking for. And as a bonus, the price is about the same as my old toner, but this bottle is twice the size! The toner comes in a 400 mL bottle with a screw-on flip-top lid. I apply it using cotton rounds, with just a few shakes of the toner onto the pad. It’s described as a purifying toner and contains salicylic acid along with other main ingredients such as water, alcohol, rose water, grape water, and peppermint oil. It smells fresh, like a soft mix of rose and peppermint. The scent is pleasant and only lasts until it dries. The toner itself is very thin and looks like water. Some toners feel exactly like rubbing water on your face, but this one has a tiny bit of slip during application. Once it dries though, there is no residue left on the skin. I really like that it leaves a light, clean tingling sensation, likely from the peppermint. What impressed me the most is that even after showering and washing my face thoroughly, the toner still picks up the last bit of dirt and oil from my skin. In my photo I had already showered, washed my face twice with cleanser, used a silicone scrub, yet the cotton pad still picked up a little remaining dirt. The only small issue I noticed is with the packaging seal. Only the lid was shrink wrapped with a small strip that gets p

avis.titre: Odeur fraîche
avis.texte: J’adore mettre ce produit le matin! L’odeur est fraîche, je trouve que ça réveille. C’est la deuxième fois que je l’achète et je vais certainement continuer.

avis.titre: Balanced, Fresh, and Surprisingly Effective for Everyday UseBalanced, Fresh, and Surprisingly Effective for Everyday Use
avis.texte: I’ve been using this purifying toner for a while now. The first thing I noticed is the texture—it’s very watery, almost like plain water, but it doesn’t feel useless. When I press it into my skin with my hands, it absorbs quickly and gives that immediate “my skin needed this” feeling. No stickiness, no burning, just a light soothing sensation. I usually use it right after cleansing in the morning before heading out, and it helps my skin feel balanced instead of tight or dry, especially around my cheeks. After a couple of weeks, I started to see small but real changes. My skin looked less dull, and I wasn’t getting that midday shine as much. The formula uses natural salicylic acid, and I think it does a good job keeping pores looking a bit cleaner without being too harsh. Ingredient-wise, it feels like a pretty thoughtful mix. The combination of salicylic acid with grape and rose water makes it effective but still relatively gentle for everyday use. I also like that the ingredient list is transparent, so you know what you’re putting on your skin. The 400 mL bottle is another plus—it lasts a long time, even with twice-daily use. That said, it’s not perfect for everyone. There is alcohol in the formula, and while it didn’t bother my skin, I can see it being a bit drying if you’re already on the sensitive side. The scent is something to consider too—it’s a fresh mix of rose and a slightly minty note (probably from peppermint oil). I personally found it light and kind of spa-like,

avis.titre: purifying toner with a solid 70/100 safety ratingpurifying toner with a solid 70/100 safety rating
avis.texte: I took a closer look at the 400 mL bottle of this purifying toner and the breakdown is quite interesting. It gets a "good" rating with a score of 70/100, which is a solid result for a daily skincare product. Using a reference like Yuka is helpful here because it flags the specific risks associated with what you are putting on your skin. Most of the components are listed as low risk, which is reassuring. You have natural clearing agents like salicylic acid and peppermint oil, but the breakdown also shows several essential oils like lavender and lemongrass. While these provide a nice scent, they are noted as low-risk factors on the app, likely due to potential sensitivity for some users. Pros -> Mostly low-risk ingredients throughout the formula, which makes it a much safer bet for a long-term daily routine. -> Huge 400 mL size that offers a lot of product for the price and ensures you won't run out of your supply quickly. -> Clear ingredient transparency allowing you to see exactly which oils and acids are included before you apply it. -> Effective purifying mix with salicylic acid and grape water to help balance the skin without being overly aggressive. Cons -> Contains alcohol denat which sits at the top of the list and can be a bit drying if your skin is already on the sensitive side. -> Multiple fragrance components like citral and limonene are present, so it might not be the best fit for anyone with a known allergy to essential oils. It does the purpose well for a reliabl

avis.titre: Love the Caudilie line
avis.texte: This is a lovely toner that leaves your face feeling refreshed. You can splash a bit on a cotton pad, and the product applies easily to your face. Some toners feel drying, or like you are just putting water on your face. This toner makes your face feel fresh and skin smooth even before applying moisturizer. This is the quality product I expect from Caudalie, and a good addition to your skin routine.

avis.titre: A nice toner if used intentionally
avis.texte: I’ve been using this toner for a while now, and overall I think it’s a really solid exfoliating toner—especially if you like skincare that feels a little more elevated than the typical acne product. One of the first things I noticed was the size of the bottle. It’s pretty big for a treatment toner, and when you look at the price per ounce it actually feels like decent value for a premium brand. It’s the kind of bottle that lasts a long time, not one of those tiny luxury toners you finish in a few weeks. The texture is completely watery, very old-school toner vibes, but the way it performs feels more modern. I usually use it with a cotton pad, though patting it in with your hands works too. It sinks in fast and dries down without any sticky or tacky feeling, which I really like. It also layers easily under the rest of my routine - serums, moisturizer, SPF, makeup - no pilling or weird texture issues. What I appreciate most is that it gives that clean, clarified feeling without making my skin feel stripped. Some salicylic acid toners can go a little overboard, but this one feels more balanced. My skin usually looks a bit fresher after using it, and it seems to help keep oil and congestion in check, especially when my pores are looking more obvious than usual. The scent is noticeable though. It has that green, herbal smell with a bit of rose water underneath. I personally like it - it smells fresh and kind of spa-like - but if you’re very sensitive to fragrance it’s something to

avis.titre: A great way to get oily pores under control
avis.texte: I got this toner to help manage my oily skin and large pores and I’m already really impressed with it. I’ve only been using it for a few days now, but it’s making a great first impression as my first foray into this brand. As someone in my late 30s dealing with oily skin and fine lines, I’m always on the hunt for something that actually works without being too harsh. I’m familiar with higher mid range skincare, but somehow I hadn’t tried this Caudalie until now. The first thing I noticed is that this bottle is absolutely huge and will probably last me forever. It has an extremely unique, somewhat piney scent that feels like a mix of tea tree and lavender or something that I just can’t put my finger on, which makes it feel incredibly fresh when I apply it. It’s like a spa experience honestly. This toner is a liquid consistency like water that layers perfectly under my serums and moisturizer without leaving any sticky residue behind. It also hasn’t caused any pilling even as I layered many different products on top of it (after it dried of course). My skin isn't overly sensitive, so I haven't had any issues with irritation even though it is an exfoliating product. Looking at the ingredients you can see how natural it is. There looks to be a lot of elements straight from nature, and of course salicylic acid is perfect for clearing out pores. It feels like it’s doing a good job of cutting through the on my face oil while still being gentle on my skin barrier. Everything about it

avis.titre: Refreshing toner tames misbehaving pores
avis.texte: Caudalie is a premium brand, and I've been using their creams every night for years. The Vinopure Salicylic Acid Pore Minimizing and Exfoliating Toner is the second product I've tried in their Vinopure line, and it meets my expectations. - which were pretty high after using the first product, a cleanser. Vinopure products excel at keeping pores in check. But, unlike many similar products, after using them my face doesn't feel as though I've doused it with paint thinner or applied sandpaper. The toner formula is exceptional. The first ingredient is water, then alcohol, and the remaining ingredients are a veritable cornucopia of fruits, flowers, and herbs including grape water and juice, rose water, rosemary, lemon grass, peppermint, lavender, and lemon balm. Because I don't see the full ingredient list anywhere here, I'm pasting it below. Although the product is unscented, the lemon and peppermint both come through for me. The scent is pleasant and does not linger. Instructions say to apply the toner after cleaning the face, and not to rinse off the toner. The toner leaves my face feeling slightly tingling and refreshed, and I have no problem applying other products (sunscreen, moisturizer, the usual) on top. I do not have sensitive skin, and I have experienced no irritation from the toner or any Caudalie product. The toner is vegan, and Caudalie avoids animal testing though I believe they are not certified as cruelty-free. Unfortunate. Ingredients: water, denatured alcohol, r

avis.titre: Lovely toner, doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. Feels nice, mild, geat value, giant bottle.
avis.texte: LOVE the product. As a borderline middle aged person (37) My pores seem so much more noticeable than they were when I was younger. For a bit of background: my skin is combination, with dry spots around my nose and cheeks because of the harsh, cold winter, and my many illnesses. I also get a bit of hormonal acne around my chin, and my forehead can get a bit shiny depending on the product. I have some freckles and dark spots from aging, and also some faint wrinkles around my eyes, and neck. I have been using the Caudalie toner for almost two weeks now. It is hard to tell in that amount of time if there is improvement. However, I've noticed that it hasn't irritated my skin at all. My skin hasn't broken out, gotten red, or have had reactions. I do feel (maybe hope) that my pores look a bit better as well. I love the way it feels going onto my skin, so I will definitely keep using it. The scent is faint, and with no negative reaction I am optimistic that it might help long term. It is also a great value. It's a nice big bottle! Just be aware, if you are giving it as a gift that it is packed in only a piece of plastic. On the one hand I love this because it is minimizing waste, but I think it's just important to be aware if you are gifting it, as some people have different expectations and preferences.

avis.titre: Great Acne-Prone Oily Skin Toner for Sensitive Skin
avis.texte: This Claudalie Vinopure Toner is great for acne prone skin! I have very sensitive acne prone skin, my skin is also very oily. I am constantly switching between products to help treat my oily skin and acne, some products make it worse and I have had many allergic reactions. The Claudalie toner is a great option for sensitive skin, as I had NO sensitivity to the product. It is very drying however, you will need a good moisturizer after using. The salicylic acid works great for treating acne and exfoliating skin. The smell is a little strong, you notice the alcohol smell right away but it dries down to a rose water smell. I am pleasantly surprised that with all of the botanicals that it did not hurt my skin, usually these ingredients give me an allergic reaction. I would use this product over many others i’ve tried. Thayers was my go-to for years but they recently changed ingredients and I can’t use it anymore. This will 100% replace thayers in my routine. The bottle is also huge and will last a very long time. The value for this toner is worth it and I highly recommend for girls with sensitive oily acne prone skin.

avis.titre: Caudalie Vinopure Salicylic Acid Toner Gentle Balanced Skin Reset
avis.texte: I normally don't struggle with oily skin or frequent breakouts but I still like to keep a good salicylic acid toner in my routine for the occasional moment when my skin needs a reset. When I'm photographing long sessions I sometimes end up with a bit of sweat around my hairline and T zone and that is when those small unwelcome white breakouts can appear. At 62 I certainly do not welcome surprise blemishes so I tend to reach for ingredients I trust. I have been taking care of my skin since I was about eight years old so I have learned which ingredients really help and salicylic acid is one of them. This Caudalie Vinopure toner is one I like to keep on hand because it feels very gentle and balanced. It refreshes the skin immediately and within a short time the small breakouts calm down and clear. What I appreciate most is that it does its job without leaving my skin feeling dry, tight or stripped which can happen with stronger treatments. My skin simply feels clean comfortable and balanced again very quickly. I highly recommend Vinopure. Thanks so much for reading my review.

avis.titre: Not for me.
avis.texte: This review is more about the recommendation process than the product itself. I purchased this after completing Caudalie’s free online consultation on their official website, which recommended it for me. After receiving it and doing more research, I realized this product is more suited for acne-prone skin, which I don’t have. It seems like a good product for the right skin type, but the consultation felt misleading in my case. I likely won’t rely on their online recommendations again. I also purchased the largest size based on the recommendation and now don’t know what to do with all of it since it isn’t suited for my skin. Sorry!

avis.titre: Leaves Skin Smooth but Smell Is Strong
avis.texte: So far this toner has been working well for my skincare routine. It helps smooth my skin and feels like it lightly exfoliates while prepping my face for the rest of my routine like essence and moisturizer. There is a distinct scent though. It smells like a mix of rubbing alcohol and essential oils, which can feel a bit strong for me. If you are sensitive to strong fragrances, this might be something to keep in mind. In terms of results, it does feel drying but in a good way that helps control oil and leaves my skin feeling clean and refreshed. I usually shake the bottle, apply a few drops onto a cotton pad, and gently sweep it over my face while avoiding the eye area.

avis.titre: Watch the dirt wipe off
avis.texte: I bought this from Sephora so idk how price compares. I learned that this brand is amazing for WOC. I have acne prone, sensitive, oily skin. And VERY BAD hyperpigmentation. Since I have used this, my dark spots have been fading and my pores are smaller. I started using this in February along with the Supergoop 40spf Sunscreen, Caudalie moisturizer, and Caudalie serum and my acne and spots are clearing, slowly but surely. Its not super drying but Be sure to use a moisturizer after this. I love watching the excess dirt that it gets off, even after washing my face. Its not till May that i started using glycolic Acid toner at night, and Caudalie toner in the morninv, which also works.

avis.titre: Pairs with the vinopure cleanser wonderfully, made in France
avis.texte: I love how this toner matches perfectly with the Vinopure cleanser, they really do compliment each other super well. The cleanser was wonderful and great for sensitive skin but I felt like the toner completes the experience more - of course it really reset my skin to a neutral place and feeling refreshingly clean. I'm still not too into the scent, a mix of rose water, pine, and herbal-something - but performance is wonderful and it's great for dry skin. You get a big ol' bottle too, I think this would easily last 8 months just like their big bottle of Vinopure cleanser! Great value by volume for Caudalie, plus it's made in France!

avis.titre: Lovely toner that tightens the pores and gently exfoliates!
avis.texte: I picked this Caudalie Vinopure toner up because I wanted to give my skincare routine a refresh. My main concern is battling signs of aging, and my skin is normal, with some dry patches that creep up around my eyes. I need to occasionally exfoliate my skin, but I’ve had trouble finding something that I can use that doesn’t tear up and dry out my skin (I use retinal, vitamin c, niacinamide, and PDRN). I’m so pleased that I discovered this Vinopure toner. After cleansing my face in the morning, on days I want to exfoliate, I use a round cotton pad with a healthy splash of Vinopure toner. It instantly gives my face a refreshing cooling sensation, and after it dries, I can feel how much tighter my pores are. My face doesn’t feel dry at all, and it doesn’t look like it either. If I don’t immediately put on a treatment, I can smell the faint scent of the rose water and herbals and it really reminds me that I’m choosing the right things for my skin. I feel like I’ve just left the spa. This bottle is pretty enormous, so it will basically last forever. Price per use is pennies, and it sure is a worthwhile investment in my skin.

avis.titre: Refreshing Minty Toner That Leaves Skin Smooth
avis.texte: This pore minimizing and exfoliating toner by Caudalie has a refreshing minty scent and works well on my acne prone oily skin. The formula is light and spreads easily over my skin, a very small amount is needed to coat the skin. There is a slight tingling feeling. I've been using it after washing my face, and it leaves my skin feeling refreshed, smooth, and lightly exfoliated. I like that the ingredients are plant derived, even the salicylic acid is derived from plants. The toner contains other natural ingredients like rose water, antioxidant rich grape water, and essential oils like peppermint, lemongrass, rosemary, and lavandin. If you're sensitive to essential oils or fragrances this may be too strong a formula for you. Following up with a moisturizer that contains a protective sunscreen is a good idea since this toner contains BHA that increases the skins sensitivity to the sun. Overall this is a nice option if you're looking for a natural toner. The bottle is fairly large, so although the price is a bit of an investment up front, it should last quite a while.

avis.titre: Lovely purifying toner good for acne prone skin
avis.texte: This Caudalie Vinopure Salicylic Acid Toner is really great. It does a great job helping to keep my skin feeling clean and refreshed without being overly harsh or drying. The natural salicylic acid helps gently exfoliate and keep pores clearer, and I’ve noticed my skin texture looks smoother and a bit more refined with regular use. I also like that the formula includes grape water and organic rose water, which help keep the toner feeling hydrating and soothing rather than stripping. It feels lightweight, absorbs quickly, and layers well with the rest of my skincare routine. One thing to note is that it is pretty expensive- it was about $42 at the time of my review. That said, the quality of the ingredients and overall formula does feel high-end, and a little goes a long way. Overall, it’s a really nice toner if you’re looking for something that gently exfoliates, helps refine pores, and keeps skin balanced.

avis.titre: slightly cooling and astringent, dries without tackiness, doesn't dry out or over-exfoliate skin
avis.texte: I love Caudalie, so I wanted to try this even though it seemed targeted a bit more to oilier skin/breakouts/clogged pores. Salicylic acid is also a great exfoliator that doesn't irritate or dry out my skin, and I do have some textured areas that could use some smoothing. This toner is watery and not at all viscous. It has a refreshing green-herbal scent that is sort of reminiscent of a spa, and I love it, and after it dries it leaves only a very faint hint of rosewater. It does have a cooling and astringent feel immediately after application, and it cleans any bits of makeup my cleanser missed without drying out my skin. On days when I have been applying SPF constantly or wear heavier makeup, I like to use a more clarifying toner, and this one works really well for that. There is no stinging or even tingling for me with this, and no irritation at all. I also like to use this on the back of my neck/shoulders mid-day to clean up a bit but I'm not yet ready for a full shower. I love the watery texture and complete lack of stickiness or tacky residue, and the gentle exfoliation is at that "just-right" level so that I never feel over-exfoliated.

avis.titre: Big bottle of fairly gentle toner
avis.texte: The Caudalie Vinopure Salicylic Acid Pore Minimizing and Exfoliating Toner has been a solid addition to my routine, especially for keeping my T-zone clearer. The formula feels effective without being overly harsh, which is something I always worry about with exfoliating toners. It does a good job helping with mild congestion and keeping pores looking a bit clearer over time. The salicylic acid provides gentle exfoliation, and my skin feels fresh and clean after using it without that tight, stripped feeling some toners can leave behind. One thing I appreciate is the size of the bottle. You get a good amount of product for the price, especially compared to some toners that come in much smaller containers. Since you only need a small amount on a cotton pad, it lasts quite a while. The scent is light and natural (likely from the rose water and other botanical ingredients), and it doesn’t linger much after application. Overall, it’s an effective but fairly gentle toner that helps keep pores clearer while still being comfortable for regular use.

avis.titre: Great quality pore minimizing toner
avis.texte: This is excellent quality toner. It feels soothing and comfortable on the skin. I have super-sensitive skin, and about 95% of the products I try make me break out in hives after a few uses. Caudalie is one of the few brands that I can use, and my skin loves. They tend to use real, natural ingredients, and the formulas are well thought out and tested. This toner works really well. My pores are tiny and hard to see. My skin is glowing. The scent is light and refreshing and disappears as soon as the toner oaks in. This is so easy-to-use morning and night. I cleanse, then use this toner, then follow with my serum, under-eye serum, and moisturizer. It's become a staple of my morning and night routines, and it works great. The current price is $42.00 for the large 13.5 oz container. This will last me at least 6 months, and it's of great quality. This is a good value and a great addition to my daily skincare routine. Recommended.

avis.titre: Love Caudalie and love the Vinopure line!
avis.texte: I’m a huge fan of Caudalie! I have been using a sample size of this Caudalie Vinopure Salicylic Acid Pore Minimizing and Exfoliating Toner and have been loving it! So happy to have a full sized bottle of it now! I have fairly sensitive skin and have had no adverse reactions. There is a slight scent to it, so just make sure to do a spot test prior to using if your skin is sensitive to scented skincare products. A little goes a very long way! I’m still using the sample size and have been for over a month now and still have a good amount left! This full size bottle will last me a LONG time! This toner really helps get rid of my blackheads and exfoliates without drying my skin out or irritating it! I have yet to notice a change to my pores, but I’m hopeful and have confidence with continued and consistent use, I will start to notice a change! Caudalie never lets me down!

avis.titre: Huge bottle, non-drying, and helps with oily skin!
avis.texte: What I love about this toner is that it does not strip the skin, but instead just removes unwanted oil and impurities. It leaves my skin feeling clean and refreshed. I hate that tight feeling I get from harsher toners, but this one is very gentle. It is perfect for my combo skin, since it helps control oil but does not dry me out. The herbal scent is invigorating and bottle is huge! I am shocked since this is a premium skincare brand. I can apply generously since the bottle goes a long way. I think it is a great value for the quality of the product and amount included.
